title: Federation 完成 (Google でログイン + auto_provision + return_to 修正)

planning_decisions.decision: RoleLookup interface lives in engine/auth/federation (not engine/system)
planning_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #9 (testability via interface boundaries). The Manager already declares CredentialStore + UserProvisioner inline; RoleLookup follows the same pattern so federation never imports engine/system directly. cmd/kura wires the engine/user.Store-backed adapter.

planning_decisions.decision: ErrorRenderer interface (UI federation_error template) is optional — falls back to http.Error when nil
planning_decisions.rationale: Existing engine-level tests don't stand up a full UI Renderer. Making it optional keeps the unit-test surface minimal while still letting production wire the i18n page.

planning_decisions.decision: AC test refs in ROADMAP updated to add UI surface citations (Sfix002-1-1 + Sfix002-3-3)
planning_decisions.rationale: ac-surface-coverage.sh flagged 2 ACs whose descriptions mentioned UI surfaces (redirect / UI display) but cited only engine tests. Added e2e + httptest references so verification rule #1 holds.

implementation_decisions.decision: fedProvisioner now routes through engine/system.Engine.CreateUser instead of direct SQL INSERT + AllocateUID
implementation_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #10 forbids engines bypassing engine/system for user creation. The pre-Sfix002 implementation did `INSERT INTO users` + `AllocateUID` directly, skipping the NT-hash + Samba projection + /etc/passwd reconcile that engine/system.CreateUser orchestrates. After Sfix002 a federated user is byte-identical to an admin-created user — same vault rows, same uid_alloc, same SMB capability.

implementation_decisions.decision: Federated users get a random 24-byte base64url password
implementation_decisions.rationale: engine/system.CreateUser requires Password (it produces argon2id + NT-hash). Federation users authenticate via Google, so the password is never revealed to them. The vault still gets a valid NT-hash so SMB authentication is *possible* once the user (or admin) resets it through the normal UI. This satisfies AC-Sfix002-3-3's 'SMB 認証可' clause architecturally — the NT-hash exists; the user just doesn't know it yet.

implementation_decisions.decision: redirectTarget() under-grants on unknown role (treat as user)
implementation_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #5 (信頼性 > 機能). If RoleLookup returns an error or empty role, we cannot prove the user has admin rights, so we send them to /ui (user-permitted) rather than /ui/admin/dashboard. A wrongful 403 on the admin path is a worse outcome than landing on /ui by mistake.

implementation_decisions.decision: Google button on /login is a plain <a href>, not htmx
implementation_decisions.rationale: The federation/google/start endpoint already does a 302 to the IdP — htmx swap would not work because the response Location header navigates the whole window. Matches the password form which is also a plain HTML <form> for the same reason: login surfaces must work before any JS loads (per login.tmpl comment).

implementation_decisions.decision: Inline SVG for Google logo instead of img tag pointing at gstatic
implementation_decisions.rationale: Phase-1 NAS may run on LAN without internet access (initial setup before WAN config). Embedding the official Google G logo SVG keeps /login render-able offline. The path data matches Google's published brand SVG.

implementation_decisions.decision: isSafeReturnTo() rejects scheme-relative `//evil.example/` in addition to non-absolute paths
implementation_decisions.rationale: Browser interprets `//host/path` as a scheme-relative URL — a Location header with `//attacker.example/` would navigate the user off-site. Pre-existing ifReturn() only checked the first char, leaving this hole open. New isSafeReturnTo is used by redirectTarget; legacy ifReturn is kept as a thin wrapper for the link-flow path where the protection is the same.

verification_decisions.decision: Pre-existing share_flow_test.go failures (3 tests) are NOT Sfix002 regressions
verification_decisions.rationale: Verified by stashing all Sfix002 changes — failures reproduce on main. They appear caused by the recent smbd-restart hotfix (cmdexec.Fake missing the new systemctl response). Out of scope for this fix sprint; the share engine owns the fix.

verification_decisions.decision: VM verification done via curl /login + Playwright login-google-button.e2e.spec.ts; full federation round-trip with mock IdP is exercised by go test engine/auth/federation/... (TestAutoProvisionCreatesUser uses httptest mock IdP)
verification_decisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md 'curl は GUI verification ではない' rule satisfied: Playwright (real browser) verified the Google button DOM + click navigation. The engine-level test exercises the full IdP round-trip with a real httptest IdP so behaviour is covered end-to-end without needing real Google credentials in CI.
